source.title: Iran war has consumed nearly 67% of US Patriot interceptor stockpile, report says

summary: Reports the ranges behind CSIS's July 27 update: 759-827 Patriot interceptors and 234-278 THAAD interceptors left, against a revised prewar THAAD baseline of 452.

claims.quote: They estimate that the U.S. has between 759 and 827 Patriot interceptors left, roughly a third of its prewar inventory.
The U.S. also has an estimated 234 to 278 THAAD interceptors remaining, down from 452 before the war.
